title: MCP Read-Only Surface Allowlist v1 — Rig Relay
principle: Every MCP tool, resource, and prompt must have an explicit allowlist classification before it can be served. No tool may be served that has not been classified. Tier 0-2 tools may be enabled after hardening phases 1-4 complete. Tier 3+ tools are blocked until cryptographic approval receipts exist.

tools.name: rig.current_mission
tools.hardened_behavior: delegate to AgentLoop._get_conversation_runtime() or SessionRuntime for mission envelope

tools.name: rig.search_evidence
tools.hardened_behavior: delegate to evidence/receipt_store for query. Return content-light summary with SHA256 hashes only.

tools.name: rig.read_receipt
tools.hardened_behavior: delegate to evidence/receipt_store. Return receipt summary with SHA256 hashes.

tools.name: rig.list_worktrees
tools.current_behavior: real — delegates to WorktreeManager with Path.cwd()
tools.hardened_behavior: add workspace_root boundary enforcement. Replace absolute paths with workspace-relative paths.

tools.name: rig.inspect_schema
tools.hardened_behavior: delegate to schema registry. Return schema summary (name, version, last_validated_at).

tools.name: rig.summarize_dirty_state
tools.raw_content_risk: low (path hashes only, no file content)
tools.hardened_behavior: add workspace_root boundary. Replace absolute paths with hashes. No raw file content.

tools.name: rig.run_readonly_doctor
tools.hardened_behavior: add workspace_root boundary. Restrict to read-only git operations.

tools.name: rig.build_context_packet
tools.current_behavior: stub — returns SHA256 of canned JSON but no actual context
tools.hardened_behavior: delegate to ContextCompiler.build_envelope(). Return content-light packet with SHA256 hash.

tools.name: rig.create_consult_packet
tools.current_behavior: stub — returns canned message, no actual consultation
tools.hardened_behavior: delegate to coordination council_invoker. Return consultation packet with SHA256.

tools.name: rig.compare_provider_opinions
tools.hardened_behavior: delegate to council_invoker for provider comparison. Return content-light findings.

tools.name: rig.run_validator
tools.hardened_behavior: dispatch to known validators (pytest, ruff, pyright, work_doctor) via ToolRuntime with sandboxed subprocess. Return receipt + output_sha256 only.

tools.name: rig.check_merge_friendly
tools.hardened_behavior: add workspace_root boundary. Return boolean recommendation only.

tools.name: rig.audit_dirty_state
tools.current_behavior: real — delegates to _summarize_dirty_state, adds recommendation text
tools.hardened_behavior: same as summarize_dirty_state with workspace boundary

tools.name: rig.propose_patch
tools.mutation_risk: medium (produces patch proposal artifact, does not apply)
tools.current_behavior: stub — returns approval_required with SHA256 receipt
tools.hardened_behavior: delegate to PatchProposal workflow. Create actual proposal artifact. Require approval receipt.

tools.name: rig.request_user_approval
tools.current_behavior: stub — returns approval_requested with SHA256 receipt, does not actually dispatch approval
tools.hardened_behavior: dispatch to governance engine for real approval flow. Require cryptographic receipt.
tools.recommended_action: keep_blocked — this tool requires cockpit-based approval UI

tools.name: rig.promote_to_preproduction
tools.current_behavior: stub — no handler in _dispatch dict. call_tool() will return 'Unknown tool' error.
tools.recommended_action: never_expose — enterprise-only admin operation requiring multi-person attestation

classification_legend.allowed_now_after_hardening: Can be enabled after Phases 1-4 hardening (descriptor integrity + roots + content-light + evidence envelopes). No auth required for local stdio.
classification_legend.blocked_until_content_light_scan: Requires Phase 3 content-light scanning before enablement.
classification_legend.blocked_until_descriptor_integrity: Requires Phase 1 descriptor integrity before enablement.
classification_legend.blocked_until_approval_receipts: Requires cryptographic approval receipt enforcement before enablement. P2+.
classification_legend.forbidden_until_approval_receipts: Never enabled without cryptographic approval receipts + cockpit-based approval UI. P4+.
classification_legend.forbidden_permanently: Tier 5 tools denied by default. Requires multi-person attestation and enterprise admin authorization.
